name: W1 — Support complet : réception, agent, validation, envoi

parameters.query:
with entrant as (
  select $1::text    as provider_id,
         $2::text    as email,
         $3::text    as sujet,
         $4::text    as texte,
         $5::text[]  as refs,
         $6::text    as categorie,
         $7::text    as priorite,
         $8::numeric as confiance
),
nouveau as (
  select e.* from entrant e
  where not exists (select 1 from messages m where m.provider_id = e.provider_id)
),
parent as (
  select m.ticket_id
  from messages m, nouveau n
  where m.provider_id = any (n.refs)
  order by m.id desc
  limit 1
),
cust as (
  insert into customers (email)
  select n.email from nouveau n
  on conflict (org_id, email) do update set email = excluded.email
  returning id
),
tick as (
  insert into tickets (customer_id, sujet, categorie, priorite, confiance)
  select c.id, n.sujet, n.categorie, n.priorite, n.confiance
  from cust c, nouveau n
  where not exists (select 1 from parent)
  returning id
),
cible as (
  select ticket_id as id from parent
  union all
  select id from tick
)
insert into messages (ticket_id, provider_id, sens, expediteur, texte)
select cible.id, n.provider_id, 'entrant', n.email, n.texte
from cible, nouveau n
returning id as message_id, ticket_id;

with valides as (
  select t.chunk_id, t.ord
  from unnest($3::bigint[]) with ordinality as t(chunk_id, ord)
  join knowledge_chunks k on k.id = t.chunk_id
),
d as (
  insert into drafts (ticket_id, texte, etaye, modele)
  values ($1::bigint, $2::text, (select count(*) > 0 from valides), 'agent-ollama-v1')
  returning id, etaye
),
c as (
  insert into citations (draft_id, chunk_id, rang)
  select d.id, v.chunk_id, v.ord from d, valides v
  returning draft_id
)
select d.id as draft_id, d.etaye, (select count(*) from valides) as nb_citations
from d;

options.systemMessage:
Tu prepares un BROUILLON de reponse pour le support technique. Un agent humain le validera. Tu n'envoies jamais rien toi-meme.

Outils disponibles :
- rechercher_documentation(requete) : cherche dans les fiches PUBLIEES de l'entreprise. Retourne chunk_id, titre, version, texte, score.
- historique_client(email) : les 5 derniers tickets de ce client.
- creer_escalade(ticket_id, motif) : transfere la demande a un humain.

Regles absolues :
1. Tu ne rediges QUE a partir des passages retournes par rechercher_documentation. Jamais a partir de tes connaissances generales.
2. Si la premiere recherche ne donne rien d'utile, reformule avec d'autres mots et cherche une seconde fois. Trois recherches au maximum.
3. Si aucun passage ne repond apres ces recherches, appelle creer_escalade puis reponds avec etaye = false.
4. Remboursement, annulation, geste commercial, donnees personnelles, menace juridique : tu n'ecris aucune reponse, tu appelles creer_escalade.
5. Chaque affirmation vient d'un passage. Tu listes les chunk_id que tu as utilises.

Tu reponds UNIQUEMENT par un objet JSON, sans aucun texte autour :
{"texte": "reponse en francais, polie et concise", "etaye": true, "sources": ["Titre de la fiche (v1)"], "chunk_ids": [12, 13], "escalade": false, "motif": ""}
